discovery.title: Ancient Maltese seafarers likely navigated by the stars
discovery.summary: Malta might be the last place one would expect a convergence of archeoastronomy and early cosmology. Today, it's better known as a billionaire tax haven and a favorite production location for big-budget Hollywood movies.
